milestones.title: Prove the release and restart contract
milestones.goal: Resolve native updater behavior and public-release readiness before wiring the product.
acceptance: A compatible pinned electron-updater version works with Electron 40.9.3 and electron-builder 26.15.3; actual macOS quit/staging behavior is recorded.
A release-review inventory identifies exact missing evidence for licenses, signed boundaries, clean machine, provider/tenant refresh, sleep/wake and the supported OS/CPU matrix.
steps: Create a native issue and isolated feature/issue-<number>-pods-auto-update checkout from current canonical main. Inspect existing unit/component and Electron acceptance harnesses.

Prototype with disposable signed bundles and an isolated profile. Prove that closing a window, normal quit, restart and a busy worker cannot skip backup or compatibility checks. Do not assume autoInstallOnAppQuit alone controls Squirrel.Mac staging.
milestones.rollback: Discard the isolated prototype; keep the installed app unchanged.
milestones.proof: Pinned-library tests verify that electron-updater 6.6.2 does not ask native Squirrel.Mac to stage a download until explicit installation. builder-util-runtime is overridden to patched 9.7.0. A disposable signed native prototype is still being notarized; full product/device acceptance remains open.

milestones.title: Design the matching landing page and publish a complete release
milestones.goal: Make the landing page feel like the existing Pods product and make download and feed refer to one validated release.
acceptance: GET /download/mac redirects only to the promoted arm64 DMG; /updates/stable/darwin-arm64/ exposes updater metadata and immutable artifacts over HTTPS without a workspace login.
A release is promoted atomically only after DMG, ZIP, checksums, signed manifest and required evidence are present. Missing releases show an honest unavailable state.

The landing-page design is produced with Claude Opus 5.5, and the execution receipt records the actual model identity. Availability is checked before this step; if the requested model cannot be used, report the limitation and obtain an explicit replacement decision rather than silently substituting another model.

Personally inspected screenshots at 390px and 1440px demonstrate visual consistency with current Pods references, a clear Mac download and usable workspace sign-in. No horizontal overflow; keyboard focus and contrast remain usable. Component tests protect download availability and login interactions.
steps: Extend apps/openape-pods/scripts/package.mjs and distribution.mjs: ZIP target, updater configuration/metadata, unique version and exact source review. Preserve signing, notarization and releaseReady gates.

Serve releases from a dedicated persistent directory behind the existing pods.openape.ai deployment, outside owner workspace data. Upload artifacts first, verify hashes and promote the small channel pointer last. Support correct content types, caching and Range requests. Keep previous immutable releases.

Inspect current desktop/workspace components, styles, tokens and representative screenshots. Give these references to Claude Opus 5.5 to design and implement the landing page in WorkspaceWelcome.vue. Match typography, colors, spacing, surfaces, buttons, icons and tone; reuse existing patterns where suitable. Integrate the download with Apple Silicon, macOS 14+, version and Applications-folder guidance, and preserve workspace sign-in.
milestones.rollback: Withdraw channel metadata and restore the previous download pointer; never overwrite an existing version.
milestones.proof: Opus model provenance is recorded. Actual Nuxt screenshots at 390 and 1440 pixels were inspected; both layouts have a visible fixture download, reachable sign-in and no horizontal overflow. Ninety relay tests cover metadata, immutable artifacts, byte ranges and welcome states. Publication preserves immutable versions and recovers identical retries. No public release artifact has been promoted.

milestones.title: Update safely inside the app
milestones.goal: Let the app discover and install updates without interrupting automation.
acceptance: Startup and six-hour checks are single-flight, retry boundedly after offline errors, and offer a manual check. The UI shows current/new version, progress and actionable failure.

Installation cannot occur while active work or external MCP users make replacement unsafe; new starts are fenced, active work drains, backup succeeds and compatibility/signature checks pass before native staging. Failure restores normal scheduling without changing saved schedule definitions.
Same/older versions, another signing team, wrong architecture, corrupt downloads and incompatible schemas are refused; development and fixture builds never enter the production update channel.
steps: Add a focused main-process updater and narrow IPC/UI contract, with German/English strings. Prefer electron-updater as the existing builder integration; pin and inventory its runtime dependencies.

Reuse and preserve src/main/update.ts checks and worker backup semantics. Verify signed distribution metadata before accepting a release, prevent new run races and handle before-quit-for-update explicitly. Provide Later and Restart and install. Never kill unrelated MCP processes.
milestones.rollback: Disable the feed; retain the old app and matched pre-update backup. Restore only after reconciling effects and remote sessions; never automatically roll back a migrated database.
milestones.proof: The implementation checks at startup/every six hours, verifies hashes/signatures/source/schema, rejects active work and external MCP processes, fences new work, checkpoints SQLite and verifies the paired full-profile/app backup before native handoff. Pods test:fast passed 1,354 unit/component and 53 browser tests. The actual update controls and refusal state were inspected using synthetic IPC data.

milestones.title: Accept and release the MacBook installation
milestones.goal: Demonstrate a real first installation and subsequent upgrade.
acceptance: A downloaded, quarantined DMG installs and passes Gatekeeper on a clean Apple Silicon profile; the MacBook can sign in without inheriting another device identity or schedules.

A signed N-to-N+1 update preserves synthetic Pods, schedules, encrypted secrets, selected profile and runtime identity, and resumes once without duplicate work; offline, corrupt artifact, busy worker and backup failure cases are evidenced.
The live public link and feed return the accepted exact artifacts, and the Test Runs report separates passing checks, release readiness and any remaining device acceptance.
steps: Run the repository gates and focused existing suites, review/merge through the native PR flow, then build from clean canonical main. CI remains manual-only under issue 1448.

Complete the exact-source distribution review, publish artifacts before enabling the website/feed, inspect actual screenshots and publish one Test Runs HTML. Deliver the verified MacBook download URL and record any owner-only physical acceptance.
milestones.rollback: Withdraw the release pointer; keep working installations and evidence. A defect after migration is fixed forward unless the matched backup can safely be restored.
milestones.blocker: The exact-source release review still has pending licenses, signed boundaries, clean machine, real provider, real tenant refresh, physical sleep/wake and OS/CPU matrix evidence; reviewed supplemental notices are absent. The configured MacBook SSH route timed out and its OS version is not confirmed.

decisions.title: One product domain
decisions.description: Use pods.openape.ai for both the download and update feed. Reuse its current host and deploy workflow; a generic static feed needs no new release service.

decisions.title: Automatic discovery, controlled restart
decisions.description: Check automatically. Offer one confirmed installation when safe; do not force a restart in the middle of a run. Native download/staging starts only after the proven safety boundary from M0.

decisions.title: Public release is a separate gate
decisions.description: Existing signed-local artifacts have releaseReady:false. Signing alone does not satisfy the current public distribution contract; complete its real gates rather than relabeling internal builds.

decisions.reference: Der Plan sollte auch vorsehen, dass wir mittels Claude Opus 5.5 die Startseite auch so designen, dass sie zum restlichen Design von OpenApe Pods passt.
decisions.title: Claude Opus 5.5 for a consistent Pods landing page
decisions.description: Claude Opus 5.5 designed and implemented WorkspaceWelcome.vue and the page metadata. Its CLI receipt reports canonicalModel claude-opus-5-5 and provider firstParty. Subsequent integration, checks and screenshot inspection were performed by Codex.

risks.title: Upgrade races and migration recovery
risks.mitigation: Fence worker starts across backup and shutdown; validate migrations and preserve the old app with its matched backup. Test external MCP process lifetime and updater event ordering on the pinned Electron version.

risks.title: Release evidence may be incomplete
risks.mitigation: M0 enumerates missing exact-source license and device evidence. Publication remains blocked until those checks actually pass; build/release work is likely several hours, with physical-device acceptance potentially longer.

sections.title: Verified starting point
sections.body: At canonical e3fd9fa8: package.mjs supports only darwin/arm64, builds dir + DMG, uses publish: never and publish: []. App version is 0.1.2, minimum macOS is 14.0. src/main/update.ts verifies signature/team/version/schema; app.ts only prepares a backup and instructs manual replacement. WorkspaceWelcome.vue contains sign-in but no download. The live root returns a client-rendered shell; the HTML-only fetch is not visual UI evidence. The local doctor passed with one existing-work warning. No update behavior has been tested yet.

sections.title: Implementation evidence and support correction
sections.body:
Full root lint/typecheck, both application builds, documentation freshness and the local check:ci contract passed. The updater dependency security finding was fixed with a targeted override; no new audit exception was added.

The proposal initially confused the Electron packaging minimum (macOS 14) with execution support. The existing main/support.ts only permits Darwin 25.6.0 / arm64, locally verified as macOS 26.6.2. The landing page displays that verified matrix. Broader macOS execution support is not implemented or claimed.

Screenshots use synthetic release 0.2.0; they do not prove a public, signed 0.2.0 release. Normal quit, native restart and full product acceptance remain separate from unit/component results.

entries.source: At canonical e3fd9fa8: package.mjs supports only darwin/arm64, builds dir + DMG, uses publish: never and publish: []. App version is 0.1.2, minimum macOS is 14.0. src/main/update.ts verifies signature/team/version/schema; app.ts only prepares a backup and instructs manual replacement. WorkspaceWelcome.vue contains sign-in but no download. The live root returns a client-rendered shell; the HTML-only fetch is not visual UI evidence. The local doctor passed with one existing-work warning. No update behavior has been tested yet.
entries.text: Am kanonischen Stand e3fd9fa8: package.mjs unterstützt nur darwin/arm64, baut dir + DMG und verwendet publish: never sowie publish: []. Die App-Version ist 0.1.2, Mindestversion macOS 14.0. src/main/update.ts prüft Signatur/Team/Version/Schema; app.ts erstellt nur eine Sicherung und fordert zum manuellen Austausch auf. WorkspaceWelcome.vue enthält die Anmeldung, aber keinen Download. Die Live-Startseite liefert eine clientseitig gerenderte Hülle; der reine HTML-Abruf ist kein visueller UI-Nachweis. Der lokale Doctor bestand mit einer Warnung zu bestehender Arbeit. Das Update-Verhalten wurde noch nicht getestet.

entries.source: Opus model provenance is recorded. Actual Nuxt screenshots at 390 and 1440 pixels were inspected; both layouts have a visible fixture download, reachable sign-in and no horizontal overflow. Ninety relay tests cover metadata, immutable artifacts, byte ranges and welcome states. Publication preserves immutable versions and recovers identical retries. No public release artifact has been promoted.
entries.text: Der Opus-Modellnachweis ist erfasst. Echte Nuxt-Screenshots bei 390 und 1440 Pixeln wurden geprüft; beide Layouts zeigen den Test-Download, eine erreichbare Anmeldung und keinen horizontalen Überlauf. 90 Relay-Tests decken Metadaten, unveränderliche Artefakte, Byte-Bereiche und Startseitenzustände ab. Die Veröffentlichung erhält unveränderliche Versionen und kann identische Wiederholungen fortsetzen. Es wurde kein öffentliches Release-Artefakt freigegeben.

entries.source: The implementation checks at startup/every six hours, verifies hashes/signatures/source/schema, rejects active work and external MCP processes, fences new work, checkpoints SQLite and verifies the paired full-profile/app backup before native handoff. Pods test:fast passed 1,354 unit/component and 53 browser tests. The actual update controls and refusal state were inspected using synthetic IPC data.
entries.text: Die Umsetzung prüft beim Start/alle sechs Stunden, verifiziert Hashes/Signaturen/Quellstand/Schema, lehnt aktive Arbeit und externe MCP-Prozesse ab, sperrt neue Arbeit, schreibt SQLite zurück und prüft die zugehörige vollständige Profil-/App-Sicherung vor nativer Übergabe. Pods test:fast bestand mit 1.354 Unit-/Komponenten- und 53 Browser-Tests. Die echten Update-Bedienelemente und der Ablehnungszustand wurden mit synthetischen IPC-Daten gesichtet.

entries.source: The exact-source release review still has pending licenses, signed boundaries, clean machine, real provider, real tenant refresh, physical sleep/wake and OS/CPU matrix evidence; reviewed supplemental notices are absent. The configured MacBook SSH route timed out and its OS version is not confirmed.
entries.text: Die Distributionsprüfung für den exakten Quellstand enthält noch offene Nachweise zu Lizenzen, signierten Sicherheitsgrenzen, frischem Gerät, echtem Provider, echter Tenant-Erneuerung, physischem Ruhezustand/Aufwachen und OS-/CPU-Matrix; geprüfte ergänzende Lizenztexte fehlen. Der konfigurierte MacBook-SSH-Zugang lief in einen Timeout, die OS-Version ist nicht bestätigt.

entries.source:
Full root lint/typecheck, both application builds, documentation freshness and the local check:ci contract passed. The updater dependency security finding was fixed with a targeted override; no new audit exception was added.

The proposal initially confused the Electron packaging minimum (macOS 14) with execution support. The existing main/support.ts only permits Darwin 25.6.0 / arm64, locally verified as macOS 26.6.2. The landing page displays that verified matrix. Broader macOS execution support is not implemented or claimed.

Screenshots use synthetic release 0.2.0; they do not prove a public, signed 0.2.0 release. Normal quit, native restart and full product acceptance remain separate from unit/component results.
entries.text:
Vollständiger Root-Lint/Typecheck, beide App-Builds, Dokumentations-Aktualität und der lokale check:ci-Vertrag bestanden. Der Sicherheitsfund in der Updater-Abhängigkeit wurde durch eine gezielte Versionsvorgabe behoben; es wurde keine neue Audit-Ausnahme ergänzt.

Der Vorschlag verwechselte zunächst das Electron-Paketminimum (macOS 14) mit der Ausführungsunterstützung. Das bestehende main/support.ts erlaubt nur Darwin 25.6.0 / arm64, lokal als macOS 26.6.2 geprüft. Die Startseite zeigt diese geprüfte Matrix. Breitere macOS-Ausführungsunterstützung wurde weder implementiert noch behauptet.

Die Screenshots verwenden den synthetischen Release 0.2.0; sie belegen keinen öffentlichen signierten Release 0.2.0. Normales Beenden, nativer Neustart und vollständige Produktabnahme bleiben von Unit-/Komponentenergebnissen getrennt.

title: Pods: matching landing page, Mac download and automatic updates
goal: Install Pods on the MacBook from a landing page designed with Claude Opus 5.5 that matches the rest of OpenApe Pods, and deliver subsequent signed releases through the same domain without replacing applications by hand.
summary: The matching landing page, release feed and guarded updater are implemented and locally checked. Public download still requires exact-source distribution evidence and MacBook acceptance.

problem.statement: The welcome page has no Mac download and the desktop only verifies manually selected updates.
problem.impact: Installation on another Mac and every later upgrade require manual release work.
problem.approach: Have Claude Opus 5.5 align the landing page with the existing Pods design and connect signed release packaging, public download/feed and an update flow that preserves active work and local state.
problem.outcome: A fresh Mac installs from the website and an installed app upgrades from version N to N+1 with its identity, Pods and schedules intact.

context: Implementation follows the approval of proposal revision 2, on feature/issue-1453-pods-auto-update from canonical e3fd9fa8d2ae384c37092884d7631c5f1d939f03. The existing shared checkout and installed Pods app were preserved. Native issue 1453 records execution; no public desktop release has been promoted.
scope: Redesign the existing Pods welcome page using Claude Opus 5.5, grounded in the current Pods interface, with a public download entry, version, requirements and installation guidance; retain workspace sign-in.
Stable production feed and immutable DMG/ZIP artifacts for macOS arm64; monotonically increasing app versions and release notes.
Automatic checks at startup and periodically, manual check, visible result/errors and controlled installation; preserve profiles, Keychain identity and schedules.
A real signed N-to-N+1 upgrade on a separate acceptance profile and first installation on the MacBook.
nonGoals: Windows, Linux, Intel Mac, App Store distribution, delta updates and a new general release platform.
Moving existing Pods or credentials from the Mac mini to the MacBook, duplicating schedules, or changing the Git mirror pipeline.
Re-enabling paused CI or publishing internal signed-local builds by bypassing existing distribution gates.
verification: Activate scripts/activate-node.sh with the README pnpm PATH, run pnpm run doctor, then lint → typecheck → app build → existing focused tests. Before deployment run pnpm check:ci per the current repository instructions; do not reactivate hosted CI.

Use Pods test:fast, relevant existing Electron distribution acceptance and relay tests. Keep permanent tests for upgrade refusal, backup/start races, publication atomicity and visible update controls because these protect consequential release contracts.

Inspect actual website and update screenshots and publish them with command results through ape-report-render test-run and ape-reports under Test Runs. A website HTTP 200 alone proves neither a visible download nor a successful update.
handoff: Finish the isolated native lifecycle probe, review the implementation PR and retain its Test Runs evidence. Complete the exact-source distribution gates and reach the MacBook before promoting a public signed release.

completion.summary: Product code and the local repository checks are implemented and passing; signed full-product upgrade, public artifact promotion and MacBook installation are not yet accepted.
